'''8th Division''' was a military [[Division/Legends|unit]] within the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] elements of the 8th division were stationed on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to defend the [[Jedi enclave (Corellia)|Jedi enclave]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="SWGTCG" /> This garrison proved invaluable when Imperial forces launched an attack from an [[Talus Imperial Outpost|outpost]] on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]].<ref name="SWGTCG2">{{SWGTCG|set=The Shadow Syndicate|cardname=8th Division Lieutenant General}}</ref>
